title: About Last Weekend

pre.en: What does Callum ask the Rota team to do?
pre.zh: Callum 请 Rota 团队做什么？

intro: 一段致歉视频：Rota 出了同步故障，开发者 Chen 录视频向受影响的用户道歉，说清出了什么事、怎么修、怎么补偿，最后还讲了一位用户 Callum 的回复。读的时候留意名词前面的「数字 + 单数名词」和带连字符的说法：a two-step fix、an easy-to-use app。

sentences.en: Hi everyone, I'm Chen, one of the developers behind Rota.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是小陈，Rota 的开发者之一。

sentences.en: I'm recording this to say sorry properly.
sentences.zh: 录这段视频，是想好好跟大家道个歉。

sentences.en: Last Saturday, the fourteenth of November, a sync problem made some chore lists disappear for three hours.
sentences.zh: 上星期六，11 月 14 号，一个同步问题让一部分家务清单消失了三个小时。

sentences.en: About two per cent of you were affected by it.
sentences.zh: 大约百分之二的用户受到了影响。

sentences.en: Some of you noticed before we did.
sentences.zh: 有些人比我们还先发现。

sentences.en: We promised you an easy-to-use app, and on Saturday it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 我们答应过给大家一个好用的 App，可星期六那天，它一点也不好用。

sentences.en: In plain words, a one-off server error copied an empty list over your real one.
sentences.zh: 说白了，就是服务器偶然出了一次错，用一张空清单盖掉了你们真正的清单。

sentences.en: It wasn't caused by anything you did.
sentences.zh: 这跟你们做了什么没关系。

sentences.en: So if you thought you'd pressed the wrong button, please don't be hard on yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以要是你以为自己按错了键，千万别自责。

sentences.en: And if your flatmates suddenly stopped doing their chores, well, that explains it.
sentences.zh: 要是你的室友突然不做家务了，嗯，原因就在这儿。

sentences.en: Your old lists are safe, though.
sentences.zh: 不过别担心，你们原来的清单都还在。

sentences.en: Getting them back is a two-step fix that takes about a minute.
sentences.zh: 找回来只要两步，大约一分钟。

sentences.en: Follow the instructions under this video.
sentences.zh: 照着视频下面的步骤做就行。

sentences.en: Open the app, then tap "Restore my list" in Settings.
sentences.zh: 打开 App，然后在「设置」里点「恢复我的清单」。

sentences.en: If you enrolled on our beta programme in October, the fix is already there.
sentences.zh: 如果你十月报名参加了我们的测试计划，修复已经自动完成了。

sentences.en: For the time being, we've also turned off the new invite link we added on Friday.
sentences.zh: 另外，星期五新加的邀请链接，我们也暂时先关掉了。

sentences.en: To make up for it, everyone affected will get a free three-month pass to Rota Plus.
sentences.zh: 作为补偿，每位受影响的用户都能免费用三个月 Rota Plus。

sentences.en: You can rest assured that your data was never shared with anyone outside the team.
sentences.zh: 请放心，你们的数据从来没有给团队以外的任何人看过。

sentences.en: If the fix doesn't work as described, drop me a line, and I'll reply myself.
sentences.zh: 要是照着做了还是不行，给我写两句就好，我亲自回。

sentences.en: When I was at university, I lived in a six-person dorm room with six very different ideas about cleaning.
sentences.zh: 我上大学时住六人间宿舍，六个人对打扫卫生的看法，六个样。

sentences.en: In those days, our chore list was a sheet of paper on the wall, and I was almost sorry to leave it.
sentences.zh: 那时候我们的值日表就是墙上的一张纸，毕业离开时，我差点还舍不得它。

sentences.en: It never lost any data.
sentences.zh: 它从来没丢过数据。

sentences.en: But we did have to learn to live with the coffee stains.
sentences.zh: 不过，上面的咖啡渍我们也只好忍了。

sentences.en: After our first message on Saturday, a user called Callum wrote back.
sentences.zh: 星期六我们发了第一条通知以后，一个叫 Callum 的用户回了信。

sentences.en: "Didn't notice. But my flatmate used it as an excuse not to do the washing-up all weekend.
sentences.zh: 「我没注意到。不过我室友拿它当借口，整个周末都没洗碗。

sentences.en: Please don't fix it."
sentences.zh: 求你们别修了。」

sentences.en: Sorry, Callum.
sentences.zh: 抱歉啊，Callum。

sentences.en: It's fixed.
sentences.zh: 已经修好了。

cards.note: to be changed or harmed by something
cards.tip: affect 是动词，effect 是名词，别拼混；受影响的人可以直接说 everyone affected。
cards.example: Thousands of people were affected by the train strike.

cards.note: 报错信息是 error message；比 mistake 更常用于机器和系统。
to criticise yourself too much or expect too much from yourself
cards.tip: 对别人苛刻是 be hard on sb；常和 so、too 连用。
cards.example: You only missed one question, so don't be so hard on yourself.

cards.note: something you say when you suddenly understand why something happened
cards.tip: 口语里也常说 That explains a lot，带一点调侃。
cards.example: "The heating's been off all day." "Ah, that explains it."

cards.note: to do what the written or spoken steps tell you to do
cards.tip: instructions 用复数；说明书英式也叫 instructions，不用 instruction book。
cards.example: If you follow the instructions on the box, it takes ten minutes.

cards.note: 恢复数据 restore data；也指修复老房子、老家具。
to officially join a course so that you can study on it
cards.tip: 英式拼写 enrol，但 enrolled、enrolling 双写 l；英式用 on，美式说 enroll in。
cards.example: I've enrolled on an evening course in Spanish.

cards.note: 英式拼写；电脑「程序」不管英美都写 program。
for a short time, until something changes
cards.tip: 说的是「先这样，以后可能会变」；放句首或句尾都行。
cards.example: You can use my desk for the time being.

cards.note: to do something good because something bad has happened
cards.tip: for 后面接要弥补的事；没有 for 的 make up 是「编造」或「和好」，意思完全不同。
cards.example: He bought her flowers to make up for forgetting her birthday.

cards.note: used to tell someone that they do not need to worry about something
cards.tip: 正式说法，常见于客服邮件、公告；口语里说 Don't worry 就行。
cards.example: Rest assured, your bags will be on the next flight.

cards.note: 英式读 /ˈdeɪtə/；日常当不可数名词用，动词用单数。
the same as someone said or wrote it would be

cards.zh: 给某人写几句话；捎个信
cards.note: to send someone a short letter, email or message
cards.tip: 口语、比较随意；line 指「几行字」，不是电话线。
cards.example: Drop me a line when you get back from Spain.

cards.note: dormitory 的简称；英国学生更常说 halls（of residence）。
at a time in the past
to feel sad because you have to go away from a place or people you like

cards.zh: 学会接受（不理想的情况）
cards.note: to accept something that is not perfect because you cannot change it
也能当动词：Coffee stains easily。
名词读 /ɪkˈskjuːs/，动词 Excuse me 读 /ɪkˈskjuːz/。
